about: Official forms, portals and sample letters that people use in lexflow's processes, for VA, DC, MD, TX, CA, FL, NY, IL, WA and NC. Each entry names its publisher, URL, the curated process step it serves, whether it is a fillable PDF, and its fee when one is stated. Organisations and official channels only; no person-level data. See docs/design/forms-research.md.

license_conviction.label: Licence denial based on a conviction

court_debt.label: Court-debt payment plan or fee waiver

fields.steps[].match: exact: the form is how the step is done; partial: the form does part of it; related: the form supports the step but is not the step itself
fields.fillable: true: PDF with AcroForm fields; false: flat PDF or Word file; 'online': web portal; null: not a form (sample letter, guide, web page), or the file could not be fetched
fields.revision: revision or version printed on the form, when it has one
fields.revision_note: set when the revision is not printed in the file's extracted text (or the text could not be read): where the revision comes from instead, and how sure it is
fields.file.permission_encrypted: PDF opens without a password but carries permission encryption (read here with the standard empty user password)
fields.verification.status: ok, blocked (HTTP 403 bot protection), robots_disallowed or not_fetched (robots.txt), timeout, http_<code>, no_official_url
fields.verification.final_url: where the publisher's URL redirected to on the last check; pages keep linking the publisher's own url

setup.title: Link official forms to process steps
setup.why: Official forms, portals and sample letters for each state's processes (fixtures/forms/forms.json), each tied to the curated step it serves, with its publisher, fee and whether it is fillable. Links are re-checked read-only; nothing is filled in or submitted.
setup.cost: one polite request per form URL (about 100 URLs, 2 minutes); no downloads kept
setup.status_rule: done when every form for the chosen states has verification.status ok, blocked or not_fetched (robots.txt) checked within 90 days; partial when some are older or failed; todo when never checked
setup.detail_template: {forms} forms for {steps} steps in {states} states; {fillable} fillable PDFs; {stale} links to recheck

checker.rate: at most 1 request per second per host (1.2 s spacing); robots.txt read once per host
checker.pdf: bytes parsed in memory for /AcroForm, /XFA and field dictionaries (after decrypting permission-only encryption with the empty user password); text read with pdftotext from a temporary file that is deleted at once

steps.step_action: Request records with reasonable specificity

must_contain: Records identified with reasonable specificity
No need to cite the Act
Name and legal address, if the custodian asks
no_form.quote: A request for public records shall identify the requested records with reasonable specificity.

steps.step_action: Request record, reasonably describing it

must_contain: A request that reasonably describes the record (as modelled)
Format of the copy, if wanted (§ 2-532(a-1))
no_form.note: An online portal exists; no numbered form.

steps.step_action: Submit written application to the custodian

must_contain: A written application to the custodian
None needed for records on the custodian's list under § 4-201(c)(2), or when the custodian waives it
no_form.quote: a person or governmental unit that wishes to inspect a public record shall submit a written application to the custodian

steps.step_action: Apply to officer for public information

must_contain: A written request
Delivered by U.S. mail, email, hand delivery, or another method the governmental body approves (fax, its website)
no_form.note: The OAG form exists but its use is optional.

steps.step_action: Request copies, reasonably describing the records

must_contain: A request that reasonably describes an identifiable record or records
no_form.quote: a request for a copy of records that reasonably describes an identifiable record or records
no_form.note: No statewide form; agencies may run their own portals.

steps.step_action: Ask custodian to inspect or copy record

must_contain: Chapter 119 sets no form or writing requirement for the request
The custodian must acknowledge it promptly; the requester may ask for written reasons for any exemption

steps.step_action: Submit written request reasonably describing the record

must_contain: A written request for a record reasonably described
no_form.quote: a written request for a record reasonably described

steps.step_action: Submit written request to the public body

must_contain: A written request to the public body (personal delivery, mail, fax or other means it accepts)
No standard form and no purpose may be required, except to check commercial purpose or a fee waiver
no_form.quote: A public body may not require that a request be submitted on a standard form

steps.step_action: Request identifiable records in person, mail or email

must_contain: A request for identifiable records
No purpose required except to apply listed exemptions
no_form.quote: A public records request must be for identifiable records.

steps.step_action: Request inspection or copies; no motive needed
Submit database request in writing if required
Ask State CIO to mediate fee

must_contain: No purpose or motive need be given
Requests for copies of computer databases may be required in writing
A fee dispute may be taken to the State Chief Information Officer for mediation (no form found)
no_form.quote: No person requesting to inspect and examine public records, or to obtain copies thereof, shall be required to disclose the purpose or motive for the request.

steps.step_action: Request a hearing in writing
Serve written denial with hearing rights

must_contain: A written request for hearing within 60 days after service of the notice of denial
The board's denial notice must state the challenge procedure, the right to appeal, and how to request a copy of one's conviction history (Pen. Code §§ 11122-11127)
no_form.quote: Unless written request for hearing is made within the 60-day period, the applicant's right to a hearing is deemed waived.
no_form.note: Each board has its own application and criteria; no statewide form.

steps.step_action: Petition board on whether conviction disqualifies
Decide petition on disqualification

must_contain: A petition to the board, at any time (including before education or training)
The board decides within 90 days of receipt
no_form.note: No DLCP or DC Health petition form was found.

steps.step_action: Submit rehabilitation and good-conduct information

no_form.statute: Md. Code, Crim. Proc. § 1-209 (as amended by 2026 Md. Laws ch. 302, HB 557)
must_contain: A predetermination request to the department (effective July 1, 2026, per the Office of Financial Regulation advisory); the downloaded § 1-209 predates it
no_form.note: No department form found; check each board.

must_contain: No pre-application request process found; a conviction more than 5 years before the application may not be grounds for denial of the licences listed in § 455.213(3)(a)
A preliminary application to the licensing authority, at any time, including before education or paying a fee
Only Department of Licensing licences and boards it supports
Written determination within two months
A petition to the board for a predetermination, at any time
A criminal history record report with the petition
Board decides within 45 days; fee capped at $45
no_form.note: Each board publishes its own petition.

must_contain: After sentencing, a court certificate of relief from disabilities is issued only on a verified application to the sentencing court
no_form.quote: it shall only be issued thereafter upon verified application to the court
no_form.note: The court's application form is on nycourts.gov, which blocked the checker.

must_contain: No IDFPR pre-application form found

steps.step_action: File ex parte expunction petition

must_contain: A verified ex parte petition with the person's full name, sex, race, date of birth, driver's licence and social security numbers and address at arrest (or why any is missing)
The offense charged, offense and arrest dates, county (and city) of arrest, arresting agency, case number and court
A list, with physical and email addresses, of every agency and private entity believed to hold the records, each state or local agency listed once
no_form.quote: must be verified and must include
no_form.note: No OCA model expunction form was found; each district clerk posts the agency list (art. 55A.253(c)).

must_contain: Petition, sworn statement and certificate of eligibility, served on the prosecuting attorney and arresting authority (forms are printed in Rule 3.989)
no_form.note: No statewide fillable PDF from an official host was verified.

must_contain: Payment plans are developed by each clerk (no statewide form)
Application for Criminal Indigent Status: form developed by the Florida Clerks of Court Operations Corporation; $50 application fee
An application to the sentencing court for resentence, at any time, if unable to pay
no_form.quote: In any case where the defendant is unable to pay a fine, restitution or reparation imposed by the court, he may at any time apply to the court for resentence.

steps.step_action: Request hearing on restitution plan

must_contain: No payment-plan or fine-relief form found; requests go by motion in the criminal case

steps.step_action: Tell the court of difficulty paying

must_contain: The defendant tells the court of difficulty paying; no form for the county and district court process

gaps: Virginia State Corporation Commission: robots.txt disallows automated clients, so LLC-1011 and the assumed-name certificate were not fetched.
nccourts.gov, nycourts.gov and dccourts.gov answered HTTP 403 (bot protection) to the research client; their forms are listed from the publishers' own URLs as indexed by a search engine, unverified.
ilsos.gov did not answer within the 15-second timeout (three tries), so LLC-5.5 is unverified.
myfloridalegal.com (Florida Attorney General) and ncdoj.gov answered HTTP 403.

Not found: a DC fillable motion to seal; a DC criminal-fine payment-plan form; DC, Florida, Illinois, North Carolina (statewide) and Washington pre-application licensing forms; a Texas OCA expunction form; a txcourts.gov copy of the Statement of Inability; the English CRO 01.0100 file; a North Carolina fee-mediation form.
